domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n is at least 2 (so that n-1 >= 1 and division by n is valid)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n at least 2 and every real x with (n-1)/n <= x < 1: for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n-1, floor of (k times x) equals k minus 1, and floor of (n times x) equals n minus 1.
quantifier_order: for all integers n with n at least 2
for all real numbers x with (n-1)/n <= x < 1
for all integers k with 1 <= k <= n-1

variables.name: n
variables.role: fixed parameter appearing in bounds for x and k

variables.name: k
variables.role: quantified variable indexing the first floor identity

witness_dependencies: The value k is independent of x beyond the fact that the conclusion uses the same n and x; k only ranges over integers with 1 <= k <= n-1.
The second conclusion floor(n x) = n - 1 depends only on the same n and x; it is not an additional existential choice.

statement_nl: If (n-1)/n <= x < 1, then floor(k x) = k - 1 for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n - 1, and floor(n x) = n - 1.
